narrative: On the bookwheel. Coatless, in his shirt, at the board. A small black-letter book lies held flat by the round pounce-box. The leaf is the feast. A bluebottle ticks at the casement. Sweat shines on the wrist that rests beside the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the leaf as texture, and did not copy it.

entities.name: Brooke
entities.context: Shown on book in The book, as texture
